about.heroDescription: Save The Paws is a central safety net for Morocco's street dogs.
about.mission1: We support vetted animal welfare organizations on the ground, fund spaying/neutering and vaccinations, and raise awareness — for sustainable, controlled, and peaceful coexistence of humans and animals.
about.mission2: The local population should be able to live free of fear, in harmony with healthy animals.
about.missionBold: Street dogs have a right to live.
about.mission3: Healthy. Protected. And free from suffering caused by deadly diseases and uncontrolled breeding.
about.mission4: To make this vision possible, we need people who take responsibility. Every contribution helps save lives and create lasting change.
about.card1Desc: Funding medical care on the ground
about.card2Desc: Vetted partner organizations in the region
about.card3Desc: For peaceful coexistence of humans and animals
about.donateDescription: Save The Paws relies entirely on donations. Your support funds vaccinations, spaying/neutering, and emergency aid directly on site.
about.appTitle: This app is part of our work
about.appText1: The community spirit of this app is a central factor in all local animal welfare work. Every report, every donation and every visit to a PawFriend strengthens the network — and makes animal welfare more capable of acting.
about.appText2: Only with your support can animal welfare remain capable of action and bring about real change with growing awareness. A big task — but together we can save lives today.

tnvr.subtitle: Trap · Neuter · Vaccinate · Return
tnvr.desc1: TNVR is the only humane and truly effective method to counter street dog overpopulation. Dogs are caught, neutered, vaccinated and released back — instead of being killed.
tnvr.desc2: Without neutering, a dog population grows uncontrolled. TNVR breaks this cycle sustainably: treated animals stay in their territory but prevent new, unvaccinated dogs from moving in.
tnvr.goal: 🎯 TNVR is one of the main goals of Save The Paws in the Agadir-Taghazout region.
